يغلل (form I)
# يَغْلُلْ (yaḡlul) /jaɣ.lul/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of غَلَّ (ḡalla)
# يُغْلَلْ (yuḡlal) /juɣ.lal/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive jussive of غَلَّ (ḡalla) and غُلَّ (ḡulla)
# يَغْلِلْ (yaḡlil) /jaɣ.lil/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of غَلَّ (ḡalla)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
